source.author: Mark Rosewater (with the Council of Colors)
source.caution: Rosewater states this is a snapshot for 2021-10-18 that will continue to evolve, that per-set needs bend the default, and that some entries are experiments that may not stick.

definitions.spells: instants and sorceries, per the article's own terminology
definitions.N: a natural number of 1 or greater; repeated N need not be equal

basis_meanings.both-agree: colour list and ability catalog state the same tier
basis_meanings.ability-catalog: the two disagree; the catalog is preferred because it is where Rosewater discusses the classification
basis_meanings.ability-catalog-only: stated only in the ability catalog
basis_meanings.colour-list-only: stated only in a colour list

flash | B.mechanism: Flash moved black from tertiary to secondary in 2021; the Black-Tertiary list entry is stale 2017 data.

+n/+n (on spells) | W.mechanism: The change log records White as primary in 2017 as well, so the White-Secondary list entry contradicts both editions.

exiling cards from graveyard | W.mechanism: Absent from the change log, so unchanged since 2017; the White-Primary list entry is a summary-list error.

creature pumping, your team, ongoing ::.mechanism: Persistent summary/catalog inconsistency in BOTH 2017 and 2021. The detailed catalog says tertiary and no 2021 change is recorded, so the Black-Secondary summary claim is a long-standing list error.

deal n damage to a creature with flying.mechanism: Absent from the change log, so unchanged since 2017. The catalog explains why: green is the stronger anti-flying colour and ordinary red burn already reaches fliers.

ruling.mechanism: The change log records White as primary in 2017 as well, so the White-Secondary list entry contradicts both editions.
